summary: Frontend-only test for CBT Try Out device compatibility (fullscreen lockdown + iPhone pseudo-fullscreen). Pre-check: backend was crashing with ModuleNotFoundError 'et_xmlfile' (openpyxl dependency); installed the module, added to requirements.txt, restarted backend, and backend recovered. Then executed Playwright flows for desktop Chromium (requestFullscreen available) and simulated iPhone (fullscreen API deleted, iPhone UA + 390x844 viewport). All documented behaviors in the review request work as specified. Minor timing issue in dialog detection was due to async exitFullscreen; dialog does appear (verified via screenshot showing 'Peringatan 1 dari 5').

test_results.desktop_chromium_fullscreen_gate: PASS - fullscreen-gate shown on tab_warning_limit>0 tryout, fullscreen-enter button requests fullscreen (document.fullscreenElement truthy), gate hides, exam-root renders without console errors.
test_results.exam_lock_class_and_viewport_meta: PASS - html.exam-lock added on exam entry; viewport meta set to 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover'; restored to original on submit.
test_results.exit_fullscreen_triggers_warning: PASS - document.exitFullscreen() -> tab-warning-dialog appears with 'Peringatan 1 dari 5', exam-violation-counter updates 0/5 -> 1/5; tab-warning-continue re-enters flow.
test_results.iphone_pseudo_fullscreen: PASS - with Element.prototype.requestFullscreen removed + iPhone UA, pseudo-fullscreen-gate renders. pseudo-fullscreen-recommend contains 'Google Chrome', 'Android', and iPhone-specific DND hint. pseudo-fullscreen-start hides gate; no-fullscreen-notice bar is shown.
test_results.mobile_layout_390x844: PASS - exam-mobile-nav visible, no horizontal overflow, m-prev/m-next/m-open-palette/m-finish-exam all functional, m-palette-sheet opens on 'LayoutGrid' tap, palette-N selects question.
test_results.answer_navigation_submit: PASS - opt-* clickable, m-next cycles through 5 questions, m-finish-exam -> confirm-submit -> toast -> navigate to /student/results/<attempt_id>; exam-lock class removed; viewport meta restored to pre-exam value.
test_results.console_errors_during_exam: No app-level errors. Only unrelated Google Sign-In FedCM/GSI warnings and pre-login 401s (expected).

action_items: CRITICAL (now fixed by testing agent): backend was crashing on import due to missing 'et_xmlfile' module required by openpyxl. Installed et_xmlfile==2.0.0 and appended to /app/backend/requirements.txt. Verify this persists in your container image.

Optional: consider calling startPseudo() automatically when pseudo-gate is shown AND tab_warning_limit is 0 (currently the PseudoFullscreenGate only renders when MAX_VIOLATIONS > 0, so limit=0 regression is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: useExamLockdown pushes an extra history entry; if the user had meaningful back history inside /student (e.g. coming from TryoutList) they must still submit to leave — expected per spec.
TryoutEngine.js finishTo() calls localStorage.removeItem for answers/flags for the current attempt only; good, prevents leaking state across students.
fullscreen.js fsSupported() returns false when `document.fullscreenEnabled === false` which correctly triggers the pseudo-fullscreen gate branch for in-app/iPhone browsers.
The exam-violation-counter aria/title is present only when max>0 which is correct.
